title: Parses the query conditions in the address
goal: Use URLSearchParams to read query strings with duplicate keys.
summary: directory link specifies keywords through q, and multiple tags can be added. Let the browser handle percent encoding and spaces during parsing.
tasks: completes readFilters(query) and returns { q, tags }. query can be preceded by a question mark.
Use an empty string when q is missing. tags is an array of all tags, retaining the original order.

example.note: get returns the first value and getAll returns all values ​​for the same key. URLSearchParams decodes query parameters.

hint: Give the entire query to the constructor, and there is no need to split it with & or = yourself.
